grammar_focus: 过去完成时(主考:had + 过去分词表'过去的过去'——在另一个过去动作之前就已完成 · 常与 after/before/by the time 连用 · 否定 hadn't、疑问把 had 提前)+ have 的用法/give 短语动词/beside vs besides(辅考:have = 拥有 = have got · give back 归还/give up 放弃/give in 屈服 · beside 在旁边≠besides 除…之外)
scene: 在乡村小餐馆吃完午饭却找不到提包、付不了账——原来是店主的狗把包叼到院子里去了,'他经常干这种事!'

grammar_card.title: 说'过去的过去'(过去完成时 had + 过去分词)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲怎么表示'在过去某件事之前就已经完成'的动作——过去完成时。构成:had + 过去分词(不分人称都用 had)。全用本课句子举例。

rows: 过去完成时 = had + 过去分词(不分人称都用 had)
I had left it on a chair beside the door.
表'过去的过去':比另一个过去动作更早完成
After I had had lunch, I looked for my bag.
常和 after / before / by the time 连用分先后
By the time I looked, his dog had taken the bag.
否定用 hadn't;疑问把 had 提前
Had his dog taken it? / It hadn't done this before.

specialRules.rule: have 表'拥有'时 = have got:He has a dog = He has got a dog
give 短语:give back 归还 / give up 放弃 / give in 屈服

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What had happened to the writer's bag?
options: The owner's dog had taken it into the yard
A thief had stolen it on the street
The writer had left it at home
It had fallen into the river

passage: After I had had lunch at a village café, I looked for my bag. I had left it on a chair beside the door, and now it wasn't there! As I was looking for it, the owner came in. 'Did you enjoy your meal?' he asked. 'Yes, thank you,' I answered, 'but I can't pay the check. I don't have my bag.' The owner smiled and immediately went out. In a few minutes, he came back with my bag and gave it back to me. 'I'm very sorry,' he said. 'My dog had taken it into the yard. He often does this!'

sentences.text_cn: 我在一家乡村小餐馆吃过午饭后,就找我的提包。

sentences.text_en: As I was looking for it, the owner came in.

sentences.text_en: The owner smiled and immediately went out.

grammar_points.name: 过去完成时——构成 had + 过去分词
过去完成时——'过去的过去'(先完成用过去完成)
过去完成时——after/before/by the time 分先后
过去完成时——否定 / 疑问
have 表'拥有'= have got(辅考)
have a bath / have a good time——have 作'进行'讲(辅考)
give 短语动词——give back/up/in/away(辅考)

stage5.stem: 过去完成时(表'过去的过去')的构成是:
"By the time I arrived, the train ___ left."(我到之前火车就已开走)
stage5.stem_cn: 我到达时,火车已经开走了。

stage5.stem: "When I saw her, she ___ already finished her work."(我看到她之前就已完成)
stage5.stem_cn: 我见到她时,她已经完成了工作。

options: 在过去某个动作'之前'就已完成的事

stage5.stem: "After I ___ had lunch, I looked for my bag."(先吃完午饭,再找包)
stage5.stem_cn: 我吃完午饭后,就去找我的包。

stage5.stem: "He told me he ___ seen the movie before."(他说他之前已看过)
stage5.stem_cn: 他告诉我他以前看过这部电影。

stage5.stem: "By the time the owner came in, his dog ___ taken the bag."(老板进来前狗已叼走)
stage5.stem_cn: 老板进来时,他的狗已经把包叼走了。

stage5.stem: 两件都发生在过去的事,先发生的那件用:
options: 过去完成时(had + 过去分词)

stage5.stem: 过去完成时的否定式是:
"___ his dog taken the bag before he came in?"(过去完成的疑问:助动词提前)
stage5.stem_cn: 他进来之前,他的狗已经把包叼走了吗?

stage5.stem: have 表示'拥有'时,可以换成:
"He has a big house." 与它意思相同的是:
options: He has got a big house.
He is got a big house.
He does got a big house.
He has getting a big house.

stage5.stem: "I ___ a bath before dinner."(晚饭前洗了个澡,have 作'洗、进行'讲)
下面哪个说法'不能'用 have got 替换?
options: have a good time(玩得开心)

stage5.stem: "Don't ___! You can still win."(别放弃,表示'放弃')
beside 和 besides 的区别是:
"Come and sit ___ me."(坐到我旁边:在…旁边)
